reference_points.judgment: 回应直接说明开放编码后进行了第二轮轴心编码，检查代码关系与模式、合成高阶类别，并把46个代码分配到四个时间阶段，具体回答了是否继续整合及类别如何形成。
reference_points.importance_reason: 本题核心要求是说明由单个代码到主题类别的整合过程。

human_sources.exact_quote: Did you stop at this stage or have further steps of integration

manuscript_evidence.exact_quote: Subsequent to open coding, we engaged in a second cycle of analysis to group these codes into broader conceptual categories. Drawing on principles of axial coding (Saldaña, 2021), we examined relationships among the codes, explored underlying patterns, and grouped them into higher-order categories. Through this process, it became evident that participants consistently described their activities in chronological sequences, structuring their accounts around distinct stages of tool development and dissemination.Based on this, we identified four phases of the tool development and dissemination process, as described in the consequent section of this paper. The 46 codes that were created during the previous analysis step were then assigned to one or more of the stages.

reference_points.match_criteria: 识别第二轮步骤、关系/模式聚合及四阶段46码映射，不能仅按提到轴心编码术语给分。
acceptable_alternatives: 可指出缺少编码片段限制审查细度，但原关切没有强制要求提供完整代码本或实施选择性编码。
